title: Well-posedness of a stochastic Navier-Stokes system with dynamically coupled subgrid scales
summary: We study a stochastic Navier--Stokes system in which the spatial modes of the transport noise evolve dynamically and are coupled to the resolved velocity. The model couples a Navier--Stokes stochastic PDE to an infinite family of linearized Navier-Stokes equations for the noise correlation modes. These latter equations may contain a hyperviscosity. We prove existence of martingale solutions in two dimensions for hyperviscosity exponent $s\geq1$, and pathwise uniqueness for $s>1$ under additional regularity of the initial noise modes.
